posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Bank of America puts 4,000 people on fixing vulnerabilities uncovered by Anthropic's Mythos and other AI models The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 18h ago • Bank of America deployed 4,000 people including 1,000 contractors to patch vulnerabilities found by AI models like Anthropic's Mythos. • AI security research is identifying software gaps at scale, forcing enterprises into large-scale remediation efforts. • This represents a shift from traditional security discovery to AI-powered vulnerability detection at organizational level. 🤖 AI Platform Apple Intelligence to enter China beta testing this month, Tim Cook confirms TechNode (China) · 🟣 Qwen · 🌏 Asia · 1h ago • Apple Intelligence begins beta testing in China this month with regulatory approval, using Alibaba Qwen models. • Apple adapted its flagship AI features for China's regulatory environment rather than launching globally identical. • Qwen integration signals Apple's partnership strategy to comply with Chinese requirements while deploying Apple Intelligence. 💳 Agentic Commerce Agentic Payments Are About to Break the Meaning of an Authorized Transaction PYMNTS.com · 1h ago • Agentic payments systems are changing how authorized transactions are defined and executed. • AI agents handling payments autonomously creates new challenges for authorization frameworks. • Article suggests traditional payment authorization concepts may become obsolete with agentic commerce. 📰 Also covered by: PYMNTS Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Google wants Gemini 4 Argon to be the only AI model robots need The Decoder · 🔵 Gemini · 17h ago • Google's Gemini 4 Argon scores 87 percent on internal robotics benchmark (ERQA). • Model handles robot control, simulation generation from photos/sketches, and video evaluation. • Demos show current versions still require substantial human guidance despite claims of broad capability. 🤖 AI Platform Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race The Decoder · 🟣 Qwen · 15h ago • Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model processing text, images, video, and audio. • Model supports one million token context window and competes with Chinese open-weight models on benchmarks. • Meta positioned this as direct response to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in open-source AI race.
